import sys

class TaskB:
    def solve(self, n, m):
        if n > m:
            n, m = m, n
        V = n * m
        if V < 100:
            g = [[] for _ in range(V)]
            for i in range(V):
                r1 = i // m
                c1 = i % m
                for j in range(V):
                    r2 = j // m
                    c2 = j % m
                    if abs(r1 - r2) + abs(c1 - c2) == 3:
                        g[i].append(j)
            res = self.maxMatching(g) * 2
            return res
        else:
            if n == 1:
                res = (m // 6) * 6
                if m % 6 == 4:
                    res += 2
                elif m % 6 == 5:
                    res += 4
            else:
                res = n * m
                res -= res % 2
            return res

    def maxMatching(self, graph):
        n = len(graph)
        match = [-1] * n
        p = [-1] * n
        for i in range(n):
            if match[i] == -1:
                v = self.findPath(graph, match, p, i)
                while v != -1:
                    pv = p[v]
                    ppv = match[pv]
                    match[v] = pv
                    match[pv] = v
                    v = ppv
        return sum(1 for x in match if x != -1) // 2

    def findPath(self, graph, match, p, root):
        n = len(graph)
        p = [-1] * n
        base = list(range(n))
        used = [False] * n
        q = [0] * n
        qt = 0
        used[root] = True
        q[qt] = root
        qt += 1
        qh = 0
        while qh < qt:
            u = q[qh]
            qh += 1
            for v in graph[u]:
                if base[u] == base[v] or match[u] == v:
                    continue
                if v == root or (match[v] != -1 and p[match[v]] != -1):
                    curbase = self.lca(match, base, p, u, v)
                    blossom = [False] * n
                    self.markPath(match, base, blossom, p, u, curbase, v)
                    self.markPath(match, base, blossom, p, v, curbase, u)
                    for i in range(n):
                        if blossom[base[i]]:
                            base[i] = curbase
                            if not used[i]:
                                used[i] = True
                                q[qt] = i
                                qt += 1
                elif p[v] == -1:
                    p[v] = u
                    if match[v] == -1:
                        return v
                    v = match[v]
                    used[v] = True
                    q[qt] = v
                    qt += 1
        return -1

    def markPath(self, match, base, blossom, p, u, curbase, child):
        while base[u] != curbase:
            blossom[base[u]] = True
            blossom[base[match[u]]] = True
            p[u] = child
            child = match[u]
            u = p[match[u]]

    def lca(self, match, base, p, a, b):
        used = [False] * len(match)
        while True:
            a = base[a]
            used[a] = True
            if match[a] == -1:
                break
            a = p[match[a]]
        while True:
            b = base[b]
            if used[b]:
                return b
            b = p[match[b]]

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    solver = TaskB()
    result = solver.solve(n, m)
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
